title: Find Your Recovery Evidence
subtitle: Progress is often easier to see when you look beyond pain intensity.
description: Notice changes in capacity, confidence, participation, recovery time, and understanding. Small changes count; honest answers are more useful than positive answers.

fields.label: Have you noticed any of these?
options: I can do something for longer or more comfortably
I recover more quickly after activity
I feel less worried about a symptom or movement
I used a strategy instead of stopping everything
I participated in something that matters to me
I have not noticed a change yet

fields.label: Describe one specific example.
fields.placeholder: What happened, and what was different?

fields.label: What may have helped?
fields.placeholder: Consider pacing, movement, sleep, support, understanding, treatment, or context...

successMessage: Saved. This gives you and your practitioner a broader picture of recovery than pain intensity alone.
